UI/UX DesignMobile ApplicationConcept Project

INEC Voting App

A mobile voting application concept designed to make Nigeria’s electoral process more accessible, transparent, secure, and user-friendly.

My roleUI/UX Designer
ToolsFigma
DeliverablesUser flow, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototype

Overview

Project overview

The goal was to explore how technology could simplify voting while building greater trust in the electoral system.

Challenge

The problem

Traditional voting processes can involve long queues, accessibility challenges, voter verification difficulties, and concerns about transparency. There is an opportunity to create a more seamless and inclusive digital voting experience.

Response

The solution

I designed an intuitive mobile experience focused on four things:

Secure verificationA simplified voter identity verification flow.
Seamless votingA clear, guided voting process that minimises user errors.
TransparencyFeatures for tracking election progress and accessing results.
AccessibilityAn inclusive interface designed with different user needs in mind.

Process

Design approach

I prioritised simplicity, accessibility, trust, and usability, creating responsive interfaces for both Android and iOS experiences.

Result

Outcome

A conceptual prototype demonstrating how thoughtful UX design can improve voter accessibility, simplify electoral participation, and support transparency in Nigeria’s democratic process.

Spectranet Self-Care App

A redesign concept focused on improving the Spectranet self-care experience through a more intuitive, accessible, and user-friendly interface.

My roleProduct Designer
ToolsFigma
Design focusUser research · UX strategy · Wireframing · UI design · Prototyping

Overview

Project overview

A redesign concept focused on improving the Spectranet self-care experience through a more intuitive, accessible, and user-friendly interface.

Challenge

The problem

As a Spectranet subscriber, I experienced challenges with payment visibility, delayed wallet updates, limited data usage insights, and navigating essential account services.

Response

The solution

I redesigned the app experience to simplify account management, improve payment transparency, and make essential features easier to access.

Simplified navigation and dashboard layout.
Improved wallet and payment visibility.
Clearer data balance and usage tracking.
Easier access to subscription plans and renewals.
More accessible customer support experience.

Screens

Key screens

Swipe through the redesigned flow, from sign-in to buying data and tracking usage.

Result

Outcome

A more streamlined self-service experience designed to improve usability, transparency, and customer satisfaction.

Shopiva E-commerce App

An e-commerce mobile app concept designed to provide users with a seamless and convenient online shopping experience.

My roleProduct Designer (UI/UX)
ToolsFigma
DeliverablesMobile app design & interactive prototype

Overview

Project overview

Shopiva is an e-commerce mobile app concept designed to provide users with a seamless and convenient online shopping experience. The goal was to create an intuitive platform that simplifies product discovery, selection, and purchasing.

Challenge

The challenge

Creating a user-friendly shopping experience that allows customers to explore products, make informed purchasing decisions, and complete transactions with minimal friction.

Process

The design approach

I focused on simplicity, intuitive navigation, visual consistency, and a streamlined shopping journey. The interface was designed to make product discovery and checkout straightforward and engaging.

Features

Key features

Intuitive product discovery and browsing.
Detailed product information.
Seamless shopping cart experience.
Simplified checkout flow.
Clean and user-friendly interface.
